scene_description: A first-person traversal through an apartment entry hall, two storage closets, a compact kitchen, and a living area. Visible interactions comprise two coat-closet leaves, two laundry-closet leaves, an integrated refrigerator door, an upper spice-cabinet door, and a lower utensil drawer.
